Welcome to the Social Anxiety subverse!

This sub is meant to be a place where people with social anxiety can discuss their problems, ask questions, give tips or just post rants. I have social anxiety myself, so I know might be frightening to post here, but there is no need to be afraid. I, and I hope others with me, will try to show sympathy and, if possible, give advice.

If you have any tips, questions, comments or ideas, feel free to reply or sent me a message.

PS: If you don't have social anxiety you are welcome too of course.
